Outline · not written yet

This is the planned structure of the chapter, published so the curriculum can be reviewed before the prose is written. Each heading below becomes a section; the last section is what you will build and test. About 70 minutes when written.

4.1 · Where data comes from

public sets, your logs, experts, and models.

4.2 · Quality filtering

heuristics, classifier scores, and LLM grading, with their failure modes.

4.3 · Deduplication

exact, near-duplicate (MinHash) and semantic.

4.4 · Diversity

measuring coverage of skills and intents.

4.5 · Mixing ratios

how much of each source, and how to tune the mixture cheaply.

What you build

A filtering and dedup pipeline with a report of what each stage removed. Every number it produces is asserted by a test, and the chapter's companion notebook recomputes it.
